title: Warehouses
description: Ozonation of warehouse facilities protects goods from mold and fungus, controls pests, extends product shelf life and creates a healthy air environment for staff.

mold-prevention.title: Mold and fungus control
mold-prevention.shortDesc: Suppressing mold growth and eliminating contamination hotspots in the warehouse
mold-prevention.content:
Uncontrolled mold growth in warehouse facilities leads to product spoilage and poor employee health. Mold spores and toxins in the air undermine staff immunity, while spoilage of goods and cardboard increases waste.

Warehouse ozonation addresses the problem comprehensively: it destroys existing contamination hotspots, suppresses new mold and fungus colonies, eliminates unpleasant odors from microbial activity.

Ozone interacts with the membrane structure of bacterial and fungal cells, disrupting their barrier function and causing cell death. Unlike chemical agents, the gas penetrates all crevices and remote corners, treating hard-to-reach areas.

For effective mold control, ozonation is recommended for 1–3 hours during off-hours. Ozone generator capacity is selected at approximately 1 g/h per 25 m³ of room volume.

equipment.title: Equipment and operation
equipment.intro: Selection of ozonation equipment depends on warehouse volume and mold contamination severity.
equipment.hvacText: For large warehouses, integration into HVAC system ensures even ozone distribution and automatic scheduling.

processModes.title: Treatment modes
processModes.intro: Ozonation of warehouse is conducted during non-working hours. During treatment, people without protective equipment must not be in the room.

steps.title: Close all windows and doors, disable supply ventilation if possible
steps.description: This maintains ozone concentration in the treatment zone

steps.title: Turn on ozone generator for 40–120 minutes depending on room volume
steps.description: Time calculation: room volume (m³) ÷ 25 = treatment time (minutes)

steps.title: After treatment, open doors and windows, ventilate for 20–60 minutes
steps.description: Accelerate ventilation by enabling supply ventilation system

steps.title: For night treatment, ventilation is not required—ozone dissipates in 2–3 hours
steps.description: Warehouse is ready for work in the morning

processModes.treatmentTable: Treatment modes depending on contamination degree

humidity.title: Synergy with humidity control
humidity.intro: Mold actively develops when humidity exceeds 60%. Comprehensive mold control includes both ozonation and humidity control. Ozone eliminates existing foci, while maintaining optimal humidity of 45–55% prevents new growth.
items: Install air dehumidification systems for humid rooms
Ensure adequate ventilation to prevent air stagnation

economics.title: Economic justification
economics.intro: Implementing ozonation in a warehouse is an investment with quick payback. Reduced product spoilage losses, decreased chemical treatment costs and lower staff illness rates create significant economic effect.
economics.tableCaption: Typical savings structure for 2000 m³ warehouse
economics.highlightBox: ROI: Typical warehouse ozonation equipment payback period is 6–12 months. Industrial ozonators have 5-year lifespan with minimal maintenance costs.

standards.title: Compliance and safety standards
standards.intro: Warehouse ozonation complies with sanitary and epidemiological requirements for facility disinfection.
items: SanPiN 2.2.4.3359-16 — sanitary standards for ozone equipment
Work zone MPC (maximum permissible concentration): 0.1 mg/m³
Staff performing maintenance must use respirator
Treatment conducted in absence of people and animals

features.title: Without product unloading
features.description: Treatment is conducted without need to empty warehouse—ozone is safe for most goods

features.title: Penetration everywhere
features.description: Gas reaches inaccessible places: cracks, seams, ventilation where liquid agents cannot penetrate

features.title: Automatic operation
features.description: Modern ozonators equipped with timers for autonomous operation during non-working hours

features.title: Safe decay
features.description: Residual ozone decomposes to oxygen without forming toxic byproducts

features.title: No consumables
features.description: Only air and electricity needed—no chemical reagents

features.title: Comprehensive action
features.description: Simultaneous disinfection, deodorization and pest prevention
